title: Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer - London / Hybrid - Inside Ir35 - £500-£650.00 per day

The role: My finance client is seeking a Data Engineer to join their Data Engineering team to help shape its cloud-first data platform, supporting monetary policy, financial stability and regulatory supervision. This is a hands on senior engineering role combining Azure platform expertise, pipeline delivery, cloud migration and technical leadership delivering output in a fast moving dynamic environment.

Key responsibilities

• Design and deliver scalable, secure and cost-effective Azure data solutions.
• Build pipelines using Databricks, Delta Lake, Python and Spark.
• Modernise legacy infrastructure and migrate on-premises data services to Azure.
• Maintain data quality, governance, reliability and observability.
• Lead technical delivery, set engineering standards and mentor engineers.
• Own solutions from requirements through deployment and production support.
• Use AI responsibly, validating outputs against engineering standards.

Required experience

• Strong expertise in Azure Databricks, Azure Data Lake Storage and Azure Data Factory.
• Advanced SQL, Python and PySpark, including performance optimisation and distributed processing.
• CI/CD using tools such as GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps.
• Data architecture, cloud-native design, source control, testing and agile delivery.
• Linux/Unix and shell scripting.
• Technical leadership, stakeholder collaboration and independent delivery of well-tested code.

Desirable experience

  • SC Clearance or eligible to achieve
  • Hortonworks/Cloudera and on-premises-to-cloud migrations.
  • Apache Airflow, data modelling and metadata management.
  • Enterprise data strategy and architectural governance.
